notes: Single-file Three.js (r128 CDN) cinematic scene. Four procedurally-built characters (Michael Jackson, Pepe the Frog, Donald Trump, Elon Musk) on hand-authored joint rigs perform a seamless 12s, four-movement Thriller loop (zombie reach + crouch, side sway, 360 spin, final pose with MJ pointing). Moonlit graveyard with glowing moon, stars, gravestones, dead trees and drifting mist; moonlight plus three moving colored spotlights, ACES tone mapping, soft shadows, dolly camera (3 modes) with handheld shake, letterbox, vignette, color grade, animated grain, title card and procedural WebAudio bass+drums. Verified headless (Chrome CDP + SwiftShader): no console errors, ~84k triangles, pose sampling confirms distinct choreography across the loop.
